title: The Queen
summary: Rook plus bishop combined — meet the mighty queen.

steps.text: The QUEEN is the most powerful piece! She moves like a rook AND a bishop combined — straight lines and diagonals, any distance.

steps.prompt: Slide the queen straight down to d1.
steps.successText: Straight lines are no problem for the queen!
steps.retryText: Try sliding straight down the file to d1.

steps.prompt: Now slide along the rank to h4.
steps.retryText: Slide sideways along the rank to h4.

steps.prompt: Try a diagonal slide down to a1.
steps.successText: Diagonals too — she really can do it all!

steps.prompt: Capture the pawn on g7 — the queen can slide diagonally too!
steps.successText: Captured! The queen combines every move.
steps.retryText: The pawn on g7 is on your diagonal — slide up to capture it.

steps.text: The queen combines rook and bishop moves — that's what makes her so strong! Next: the tricky knight.
